scope: Isolated manual-feed DB; worker disabled; historical/source transports are explicitly identified browser fixtures; no financial or external notification submissions

checks.name: Service worker accepts null, primitive and object push data without an uncaught exception
HTTP client reports timed-out mutation outcomes as unconfirmed and permits bounded historical fallback time
Worker state updates on Agent team and running configuration alone is not labeled operations on
Stale policy form is refused without undoing another operator; reopening applies the fresh policy
Historical chart keeps the prior symbol with prior data while another symbol is loading
Collection forces a new evidence snapshot after an older in-flight source read
Failed browser cleanup still disables the desk subscription, clears local ownership and reports the error
A missing position mark is labeled missing rather than stale, using a UI-only receipt fixture
All eleven desktop navigation views render without page errors
Mobile navigation closes after selecting the actual book view
No uncaught browser exceptions during audit flows
QA interactions leave the strategy registry and order/fill books empty
